channel.title: Journal Media Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Journal Media Ltd (thejournal.ie)

item.title: Limerick's directly elected mayor says councillors doing 'all they can' to make job 'unbearable'
item.description: John Moran was elected as the country’s first ever Directly Elected Mayor in 2024 in a bid to shake up powers in local councils.

item.title: Poll: How much do you save each month?
item.description: A new savings scheme is set to be approved by the government “in the first half of this year”.

item.title: Landlord group claims State rental sector body has left videos which 'vilify landlords' up online
item.description: The videos were posted by the RTB in September as part of a campaign aimed at students and landlords.

item.title: Multiple arrests as gardaí seize drugs and 44 illegal bikes and scramblers in Ballymun
item.description: Four men and a teenager were arrested during the operation today.

item.title: Rain warning in effect for 17 counties as gardaí warn drivers of dangerous driving conditions
item.description: Separately, counties Wexford, Wicklow, Dublin, Meath and Louth have been placed under a Status Yellow wind warning.

item.title: Puppy farms, sulky racing, fox hunting and hare coursing: Ireland has a major animal cruelty crisis
item.description: While the public demands change, Ireland’s weak laws, poor enforcement and Government inaction are allowing puppy farms, blood sports and racing abuses to flourish, writes Jennifer Whitmore.

item.title: Emer Currie: The new Right to Remote Work Bill will not improve access to remote work
item.description: The Fine Gael TD says instead of chasing an unworkable legal entitlement to remote work, Ireland should instead focus on becoming a global hub for high-value remote-first jobs.

item.title: Government confirms plan to restrict social media for teenagers
item.description: It’s understood Cabinet will discuss measures concentrating on restrictions for under 16s.

item.title: LIVE: 'All areas' at risk of fresh flooding as rain warning in place for 17 counties
item.description: Met Éireann has placed all of Leinster – and counties Cavan, Monaghan, Cork, Tipperary and Waterford – under a rain warning until 11pm tonight.

item.title: Special Needs Assistants u-turn the talk of the Dáil amid government backlash from its own TDs
item.description: TDs from opposition and government parties say they were receiving worried calls from local schools.
